group-2023-yi-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇介绍室内植物（indoor plants）的说明文，采用标题—问答式结构，依次回答 What are indoor plants? / Why are indoor plants good for you? / Which plants can you grow? 三个小标题问题。七选五的五个空分布在引言段和三个主体板块，考查段首主题句、段尾衔接句以及引语内的概括与指代衔接。

discourseStructure.summary: 引言段点明室内植物是家庭中被低估的'幕后英雄'并总述其益处；随后用三个设问小标题依次界定室内植物、说明其益处、推荐易养品种，形成总—分的清晰脉络。

units.heading: Indoor plants overview
units.summary: 引言段总述室内植物虽看似无用，实则能改善心情、减压、助记忆，且易养价廉。

units.heading: What are indoor plants?
units.summary: 界定室内植物，指出许多品种不宜在英国户外尤其冬季生长，更适合室内。

units.heading: Why are indoor plants good for you?
units.summary: 借专家与研究说明室内植物能提升心情、创造力、专注力和记忆，并净化空气。

units.heading: Which plants can you grow?
units.summary: 推荐芦荟、和平百合、吊兰等易养品种，并指出养护与了解习性本身即是乐趣。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: they are the unsung heroes of the home.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: but studies have shown that they can promote

mechanismSignals.signalText: Not only do they look beautiful
mechanismSignals.targetText: but studies have shown that they can promote
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 Not only... 与空后 but 构成 not only...but 递进关联：不仅好看，而且有益身心。

mechanismSignals.signalText: but studies have shown that they can promote
mechanismSignals.targetText: Not only do they look beautiful
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 but 是 not only...but 结构的后半，要求空内填入以 Not only 开头的分句。
选项的 look beautiful 与前句 unsung heroes 同属对植物外在/价值的描述话题场。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后以 but 引出'有益健康'的转折，需与之搭配 Not only do they look beautiful，构成'不仅好看，而且有益'的 not only...but 递进逻辑。

matchedClues.contextSide: but studies have shown that they can promote people's wellbeing
matchedClues.optionSide: Not only do they look beautiful
matchedClues.relation: Not only 与 but 配对，前半讲外观，后半讲健康益处。

keyDistractors.reason: C 也讲益处，但无法与空后的 but 构成 not only...but 的固定关联，逻辑标记不匹配。

q-2023-yi-036.teachingNote: 看到空后的 but，优先在选项里找能与之搭配的 not only，靠关联词配对定位答案。

topicClues: are not ideally suited to growing outside in the UK

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: are not ideally suited to growing outside in the UK

mechanismSignals.targetText: are not ideally suited to growing outside in the UK
mechanismSignals.relation: Instead 引出与前句'不宜户外生长'相对的替代情况：而在室内更好。

mechanismSignals.signalText: are not ideally suited to growing outside in the UK
mechanismSignals.relation: 前句的否定'不宜户外'为 Instead 提供了被替换的对立项。
选项 where it is warmer 与前文 especially in the winter 同属'冬季/温度'话题场，解释室内更宜。

optionFit.fitSummary: 前句说许多品种不宜在英国户外尤其冬季生长，空处用 Instead 转折引出'反而在更暖的室内长得更好'，并呼应 indoors 主题。

matchedClues.contextSide: not ideally suited to growing outside in the UK, especially in the winter
matchedClues.optionSide: Instead, they grow better inside, where it is warmer
matchedClues.relation: outside 对 inside、winter 对 warmer，Instead 完成对立替换。

keyDistractors.reason: A 'All plants are different' 泛泛而谈差异，无法承接前句'户外不宜'的具体对比，缺少 inside/warmer 的话题呼应。

q-2023-yi-037.teachingNote: 前句出现 not...outside 的否定时，段尾常用 Instead 引出 inside 的对立替代，抓对比词与反义词定位。

topicClues: plants around the house can really lift your mood
clean the air around them by removing harmful gases

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Will Spoelstra, who works at the Royal Botanic Gardens
contextEvidence.afterQuote: plants around the house can really lift your mood

mechanismSignals.targetText: lift your mood / improve creativity, focus and memory
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项的 many benefits 概括了下文 lift your mood、improve creativity 等多项好处。

mechanismSignals.signalText: plants around the house can really lift your mood
mechanismSignals.targetText: many benefits to growing plants indoors
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后'提升心情'是 benefits 的具体例证，与选项的 benefits 总述对应。
空后罗列 creativity、focus、memory 等多重益处，印证 benefits 的概括统领。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空位于专家引语开头，作主题句；下文以 lift your mood、improve creativity 等列举具体好处，正好被 There are many benefits to growing plants indoors 统领。

matchedClues.contextSide: lift your mood / improve creativity, focus and memory
matchedClues.optionSide: There are many benefits to growing plants indoors
matchedClues.relation: benefits 总述与后文多项具体益处构成总分关系。

keyDistractors.reason: B 'Not only do they look beautiful' 需后接 but 配对，此处下文并无 but 转折，且 36 题已占用。

q-2023-yi-038.teachingNote: 段首/引语开头的空多为主题句，找下文反复列举的同类要点，用能统领它们的概括句填空。

topicClues: clean the air around them by removing harmful gases
remove some harmful chemicals from paints or cooking

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: remove some harmful chemicals from paints or cooking.

mechanismSignals.targetText: remove some harmful chemicals from paints or cooking
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 are among the best 承接前文净化空气、去除有害物的功效，指出哪些植物在这方面表现最佳。

mechanismSignals.signalText: remove some harmful chemicals from paints or cooking
mechanismSignals.targetText: Plants like peace lilies and devil's ivy are among the best
mechanismSignals.relation: 前文讲植物净化、去除有害化学物的能力，空处顺势点出在此方面表现最佳的具体品种。

mechanismSignals.targetText: pot plants can clean the air
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项列举的具体盆栽品种与前文 pot plants 净化空气的话题场一致。

optionFit.fitSummary: 前文反复说盆栽能净化空气、去除有害气体与化学物，段尾空处用 Plants like peace lilies and devil's ivy are among the best 指出在这方面表现最佳的具体品种。

matchedClues.contextSide: clean the air around them by removing harmful gases / remove some harmful chemicals
matchedClues.optionSide: Plants like peace lilies and devil's ivy are among the best
matchedClues.relation: the best 紧扣前文净化空气这一功效，落到最擅长此事的品种。

keyDistractors.reason: A 'All plants are different' 强调差异，与前文'净化空气'的功效叙述脱节，无法收束该段。

q-2023-yi-039.teachingNote: 段尾衔接空要顺着前文的功效话题场延伸，用同场词（best 承接净化功效）锁定具体补充句。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Learning about the requirements of each plant
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 It 指代空内填入的 Learning about the requirements of each plant 这件事，要求空填可作 It 先行词的名词性主语。

mechanismSignals.signalText: Learning about the requirements of each plant

mechanismSignals.targetText: part of the joy of owning plants

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后用 It can bring a new interest and focus 回指空内内容，需填一个可作 It 先行词的名词性主语；G 的 Learning about the requirements... can be very rewarding 既被 It 回指，又呼应前文 the joy of owning plants。

matchedClues.optionSide: Learning about the requirements of each plant can be very rewarding

keyDistractors.reason: F 'Changing the pot... will also help' 谈换盆养护，无法被空后的 It（带来兴趣与专注）自然回指，指代链断裂。

q-2023-yi-040.teachingNote: 空后出现 It/This 等代词时，空内须填可被其回指的名词性主语，按代词先行词反推选项。
